rules.title: One declared camera setup per shot
rules.statement: Every shot declares exactly one camera setup from the camera library vocabulary.

rules.title: Stay on one side of the line
rules.statement: A scene declares its line-of-action side; every shot in the scene declares the same side.

rules.title: Joins are continuous
rules.statement: At every join declared continuous, the perceptual-hash distance between the previous take's true last frame and the next take's first frame stays within the calibrated threshold.

rules.title: Takes match the declared format
rules.statement: Every take decodes at the declared frame rate and resolution.

rules.title: Durations are feasible and sum to N
rules.statement: Shot count and per-shot planned durations sit inside the slot's window and sum exactly to the target seconds.

provenance.note: creator decree 2026-09-04: every shot is 20 to 30 seconds; 20 to 30 shots per film

rules.title: Establish before you go close
rules.statement: The first shot at a new location is a wide or full setup before any close setup at that location, unless the shot declares an intentional override, which is recorded.

rules.title: Takes cover their planned seconds within budget
rules.statement: Each take measures at least its planned duration and overshoots by no more than the per-take allowance calibrated from measured model jitter.

provenance.note: creator decree 2026-08-31: 20-30 shots per film; allowance 0.06s set from measured take jitter 0.042-0.056s across 12 real renders

rules.title: The timeline lands on N
rules.statement: The assembled film measures within the scaled tolerance of the target seconds: the base half-second or the per-take allowance times the shot count, whichever is larger.

provenance.note: creator decree 2026-08-31: at 20-30 shots a fixed half-second is physically impossible against measured per-take jitter; tolerance scales with k

rules.title: No dead air
rules.statement: No take contains black or frozen segments beyond the calibrated fraction.

rules.title: Cut on action
rules.statement: A join lands inside a movement, not after it settles; stillness at a cut is a choice, never a default.

rules.title: Coverage earns its close-ups
rules.statement: A close setup pays off something the wider coverage set up; it is never the first acquaintance with a subject.

rules.title: A cut changes the image
rules.statement: At every join declared a cut, the perceptual-hash distance between the adjoining frames must exceed the calibrated change threshold — a cut that changes nothing is a continuation wearing a cut's name.

provenance.note: creator, 2026-08-31: "No storytelling in the shot — really really bad job according to all metrics" — all six joins measured 0-3/64 bits; the film had no cuts at all
